units.turn: one composer message (classify_intent runs once per agent-mode turn: sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1651)
units.deep_run: one DEEP research run (entity_match runs once per retrieved web row: sidecar/services/research/deep.py:725)
units.session: one composer turn that runs one DEEP research brief (the unit the totals use)

decisions.per_session_derivation: every web row that becomes a source passed row_relevant() once (deep.py:725 -> relevance.py:601 -> entity_match); r2-deep-cgpower captured 13 web URLs (surface/research-briefs/EVIDENCE.md:30, :73). Rows scored and dropped are not logged, and news items scored by gate_news are not counted, so the true count is higher and unknown.
decisions.latency_note: pure in-process function, never timed in r15 evidence

decisions.path_today: heuristic; paid planner pre-pass on compound turns only
decisions.per_session_derivation: classify_intent runs once per agent-mode turn (agent_runtime.py:1651); probes show one IntentResult per message (surface/composer-chat/52-intent-gate-probe.txt, 20 lines; surface/portfolio-notes/30-intent-gate-portfolio-notes.txt, 15 lines). A compound turn calls it a second time (agent_runtime.py:1604) and then makes one paid decompose() call (agent_runtime.py:1617) when the turn is not read-only and the provider is in _PLANNER_PROVIDERS (agent_runtime.py:101, :1712).
decisions.latency_note: classify_intent is never timed; the planner call is capped at _PLANNER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 20.0 (agent_runtime.py:1007) but its own latency is not measured. A whole compound turn on gpt-4o-mini took 5.6 s (spend-ledger.jsonl:54).
decisions.cost_note: the classification is $0. A compound turn adds one paid planner call; the whole compound turn cost $0.001399 on gpt-4o-mini (spend-ledger.jsonl:54, tag s2a-cc-plan-4omini). The planner's share of that figure is unknown.
decisions.keyless_note: the classification runs keyless. The planner pre-pass is skipped entirely on the local ollama path (agent_runtime.py:98-101)

decisions.per_session_derivation: no code decides whether a news item concerns a portfolio holding. The scout's site (relevance.py:623 gate_news) matches news to the bound RESEARCH TARGET, not to holdings, so it moved to entity_match. It is the same shape and the closest reusable code.

no code compares a filing sentence with a written thesis. It exists only as backlog idea BL-09 / quant-9. The closest analogue is the ULTRA numeric cross-check (sidecar/services/research/verify.py:120 _parse_verdict: AGREE/DISAGREE/UNVERIFIED over a claim against fresh evidence). It runs only when profile.cross_check is set (agent_tools/deep_research.py:302) and makes 1 extract call plus at most _MAX_CLAIMS = 5 verdict calls (verify.py:80) on the run's own model. Those calls are not metered by the ledger (surface/research-briefs/EVIDENCE.md:147-148). This analogue is not counted in the totals.
